review_text: Who doesn’t like donuts to munch on? Found on Shell Gas Station Ulas grounds. Quick as this has a drive-thru facility. The donut box for munchkins? That I did not expect. Wish they would add more variety to their existing flavors. In the pic it didn’t look like an assortment of the four (4) kinds they currently have.
For quick donut and coffee fix. I was just unlucky because the spanish latte was not availbale when I was there. I always find this place nice.

The place is quiet and less people especially late hours. Great place for coffee lovers. They also offer affordable donuts and coffee. My overall experience was all good but I'm not sure during daytime how this place run.

We all loved the first donut. This is the best Dunkin' Donuts location thus far. The atmosphere at the Shell gas station and the drive-through Dunkin Donuts was incredible. The place is really tidy and well-organized. A place to have a quick made coffee and your choice of doughnuts.

Dunkin' Donuts really deserves a 5-star rate. Doughnut is good, coffee is really authentic and staff are approachable! For those who are trying to purchase doughnuts in hurry, they also have drive thru. Kudos to more Dunkin' Donuts branch!

The best and also my favorite branch! 🍩💘 They operate 24/7. They also have Drive-Thru and wide parking space. Lastly, they have a wide selection of donuts and drinks. Very budget-friendly. It’s a good place to stay and chill any time of the day, especially that it’s cold inside. I bet you might want to bring jacket at night. The staffs are nice and they let you enjoy your visit at peace. They’re well-trained. The store shares comfort room with Shell and Shell Select customers. It’s only a walking distance and located behind Shell Select. It’s spacious and kept clean at all times. Great place in times of emergency. 👀🤣 You can buy food from Shell Select then eat it inside the store premises (syempre noh you have to buy from them as well), and vice versa. Nice diba? Usually late at night, there’s a group of motorcycle drivers who like to roar their engine and drive around the premises. It already happened for quite a number of times, so I’m guessing permi gyud na diha. Distorbo ug papansin kaayo. Hay nako. :p Dear mgt, pls hear my plea. Char.

So every month we buy a box or bucket of munchkins. And since my husband became disabled we have a PWD id that we show and get discounts. So from January to current we use the id and get discounts. Every now and then I bring or take my husband with me just so he can get out and see the outside. Unfortunately recently DunkinDonut has this policy that the owner of the ID should be present. And it's not like it's easy for someone like me 5'2 to always or at least monthly take my husband with me who is 5'11 and weighing over 63lbs. Staff would say that it is a company policy that PWD must be present in order the discount to be applied. Eh pano nalang palang and hindi talaga nakakalakad at walang assistance. I am not saying that tanggalin nila ang policy all I am saying is that if you second guess the validity of the id you can ask for an authorization letter, a gov't id of the pwd card owner, picture or medical notes if you like. But to demand us to always bring our patient with us everytime we make a purchase is just simplying disappointing and exhausting. Good Day.
